purpose: Planning dimensions for independent future training-side prompt families; no sealed-evaluation changes
invariants: Assign only applicable actor roles; primary and secondary roles must differ in goal or permission, not merely name.
Both wording variants of a family share exactly the same structured contract and split.
Every family has observable interactions, failure or recovery behavior, concrete browser assertions and applicable pinned rule IDs.
Repair families require a runnable original and verified defect and are not interchangeable with generation families.
Do not reuse sealed evaluation families, topics, design targets or near-duplicate scaffold and prompt clusters.
Static rendering does not satisfy an archetype's declared interaction. No real payments, secrets or unlicensed assets.

archetypes.journey: start > keyboard/touch action changes play state > terminal state > restart
archetypes.observable: state, result and restart differ visibly

archetypes.journey: change input > diagram and explanation update > reset
archetypes.observable: outputs respond to changed inputs, not a static illustration

archetypes.journey: configure example > run in sandbox > inspect result/error
archetypes.observable: different inputs produce different results and invalid inputs show recovery

archetypes.journey: read lesson > answer > receive feedback > resume
archetypes.observable: progress and feedback survive reload for the learner

archetypes.journey: filter index > read deep link > publish revision
archetypes.observable: public article reflects authorized revision after reload

archetypes.journey: search > follow cross-link > inspect citation/history
archetypes.observable: search and link resolve specific content; revisions are distinguishable

archetypes.journey: browse collection > submit or bookmark > moderation
archetypes.observable: contribution status and moderated visibility change appropriately

archetypes.journey: search > switch version > open example
archetypes.observable: versioned result and runnable/copyable example are correct

archetypes.journey: filter products > choose variant > add to cart
archetypes.observable: correct variant, stock and price appear in cart

archetypes.journey: change quantity > review totals/shipping > simulated payment > receipt
archetypes.observable: server receipt survives reload; totals match and staff sees order

archetypes.journey: inspect cards > compare details > choose option
archetypes.observable: comparison reflects selected items and selection advances to a next step

archetypes.journey: toggle billing period > compare limits > select tier > enroll
archetypes.observable: price/limits update and selected tier persists through signup

archetypes.journey: compare use cases > select plan > create workspace > onboard
archetypes.observable: workspace and plan survive reload with admin ownership

archetypes.journey: sign up > sign out/in > reset credential > revisit protected route
archetypes.observable: server sessions and recovery work without exposing another account

archetypes.journey: create item > invite or assign > check member access
archetypes.observable: authorized member sees update; outsider cannot access item

archetypes.journey: filter time range > inspect chart/table > save setting
archetypes.observable: chart and table agree and saved setting survives reload

archetypes.journey: check availability > reserve > reload > cancel
archetypes.observable: slot and staff roster reflect reservation and cancellation

archetypes.journey: search/filter > open detail > submit or update listing
archetypes.observable: stored listing appears in filter and detail after reload

archetypes.journey: discover event > register > manage attendance
archetypes.observable: registration and organizer capacity reflect saved state

archetypes.journey: open ticket > agent replies > requester checks status
archetypes.observable: history persists with role-appropriate access

archetypes.journey: answer branching questions > review > submit > inspect result
archetypes.observable: branch changes next question and submitted result matches answers
